// 1e24 shares == 1e18 assets on an empty vault\n    }\n\n    function test_reentrantDepositIsBlocked() public {\n        ReentrantERC20 hook = new ReentrantERC20();\n        SaveVault v = SaveVault(factory.createVault(address(hook)));\n\n        hook.mint(attacker, 1_000e18);\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        hook.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n\n        hook.arm(address(v), abi.encodeCall(SaveVault.deposit, (1e18, attacker)));\n\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        vm.expectRevert(ReentrancyGuard.ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall.selector);\n        v.deposit(10e18, attacker);\n    }\n\n    function test_reentrantRedeemIsBlocked() public {\n        ReentrantERC20 hook = new ReentrantERC20();\n        SaveVault v = SaveVault(factory.createVault(address(hook)));\n\n        hook.mint(attacker, 1_000e18);\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        hook.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        uint256 shares = v.deposit(10e18, attacker);\n\n        hook.arm(address(v), abi.encodeCall(SaveVault.redeem, (shares / 2, attacker, attacker)));\n\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        vm.expectRevert(ReentrancyGuard.ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall.selector);\n        v.redeem(shares, attacker, attacker);\n    }\n\n    /// USDT-style: no boolean return value. SafeERC20 must not treat that as failure.\n    function test_nonReturningTokenWorks() public {\n        NoMetadataNoReturnToken usdt = new NoMetadataNoReturnToken();\n        SaveVault v = SaveVault(factory.createVault(address(usdt)));\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000e18);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = v.deposit(1_000e18, alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        assertEq(v.redeem(shares, alice, alice), 1_000e18);\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Input validation\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    function test_zeroValueCallsRevert() public {\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(SaveVault.ZeroAmount.selector);\n        vault.deposit(0, alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(SaveVault.ZeroAmount.selector);\n        vault.mint(0, alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(SaveVault.ZeroAmount.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(0, alice, alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(SaveVault.ZeroAmount.selector);\n        vault.redeem(0, alice, alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(SaveVault.ZeroAmount.selector);\n        vault.donate(0);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    function test_zeroReceiverReverts() public {\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(SaveVault.ZeroAddress.selector);\n        vault.deposit(1e6, address(0));\n\n        vault.deposit(1e6, alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(SaveVault.ZeroAddress.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(1, address(0), alice);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    function test_cannotWithdrawSomeoneElsesShares() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.redeem(shares, bob, alice);\n    }\n\n    /// Third-party tokens sent here by mistake are unrecoverable — there is no rescue hook,\n    /// and by design nothing can move the underlying except share redemption.\n    function test_noRescueFunctionExists() public {\n        MockERC20 stray = new MockERC20(\"Stray\", \"STR\", 18);\n        stray.mint(address(vault), 1e18);\n        assertEq(stray.balanceOf(address(vault)), 1e18);\n        // Nothing in the ABI can move it; asserted by the absence of any owner/admin entry point.\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 0, \"stray token must not count as underlying\");\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Fuzz\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// A depositor can never redeem more than they put in when no yield arrived.\n    function testFuzz_noValueCreatedOnRoundTrip(uint256 seed, uint128 aliceIn, uint128 bobIn) public {\n        aliceIn = uint128(bound(aliceIn, 1e6, 1_000_000e6));\n        bobIn = uint128(bound(bobIn, 1e6, 1_000_000e6));\n        uint256 yield_ = bound(seed, 0, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(aliceIn, alice);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(bobIn, bob);\n\n        if (yield_ > 0) {\n            vm.prank(keeper);\n            usdc.transfer(address(vault), yield_);\n        }\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceOut = vault.redeem(aliceShares, alice, alice);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobOut = vault.redeem(bobShares, bob, bob);\n\n        // Nobody can extract more than the vault ever held.\n        assertLe(aliceOut + bobOut, uint256(aliceIn) + bobIn + yield_);\n        // Each depositor gets back at least their principal minus rounding dust.\n        assertGe(aliceOut + 1, aliceIn);\n        assertGe(bobOut + 1, bobIn);\n    }\n\n    function testFuzz_donationCannotStealFromExistingHolder(uint128 depositIn, uint128 donation) public {\n        depositIn = uint128(bound(depositIn, 1e6, 1_000_000e6));\n        donation = uint128(bound(donation, 0, 1_000_000e6));\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(depositIn, {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdUUEN3aEATw6agitMosC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Done. `forge build` is clean and all 27 tests pass.\n\n**What's there**\n\n- `src/SaveVaultFactory.sol` — permissionless registry, one vault per token via CREATE2 (salt = token address, so `predictVault()` works before deployment and duplicates are structurally impossible). The receipt token *is* the vault.\n- `src/libraries/TokenMetadata.sol` — non-reverting `symbol()`/`decimals()` reader (raw staticcall + manual decode, since `abi.decode` of malformed returndata reverts in the caller's frame and would brick listing).\n- `NOTES.md`, deploy script, 27 tests including fuzz and adversarial token mocks.\n\n**The two things the design turns on**\n\n`totalAssets()` is the vault's live balance, not a counter — that's what makes \"the keeper just transfers tokens in\" work with zero accounting: `totalSupply` doesn't move, so every share's claim rises at once.\n\nThe cost of that is that a *donation* is indistinguishable from *yield*, which is exactly the ERC-4626 inflation attack. Handled with `_decimalsOffset() = 6` (1e6 virtual shares). In the test, the attacker locks 100× the victim's deposit, skims 0.005%, and ends the trade down.\n\n**Judgment calls worth your review**\n\n- **No owner, no pause, no upgrade, no rescue.** Right call for permissionless listing — an admin key that could freeze any vault is a censorship vector. But it means no emergency stop if a listed token turns malicious, and stray tokens sent to a vault are permanently unrecoverable. Flagged in NOTES with the alternative shape if you want one (deposit-only pause behind a timelock, never withdrawals).\n- **Two deliberate ERC-4626 deviations**, both for fee-on-transfer tokens: `deposit` mints on the measured balance delta (so it can return less than `previewDeposit` quoted), and `mint` reverts rather than minting fewer shares than asked. The alternative in both cases is silently socialising the fee onto existing depositors.\n- Receipt tokens have **underlying decimals + 6** — svUSDC is 12 decimals, not 6 or 18. Any frontend hardcoding 18 will be off by 1e6.\n\n**Not done:** Slither and Mythril aren't installed here, so neither ran — that's listed as outstanding in NOTES along with an invariant suite and audit.
